review_text: Place is very nice.. And was not busy.. But a hot chocolate and waffle took 30 mins to make... Yes 30 mins.... Not sure from the photo it's a 30 minute waffle!!.. Hmm the taste was OK.. Just ok

place_name: The Coffee Bar, Gaisano Mall of Toril
review_text: Stumbled upon this coffee shop near me on Maps. Menu prices rival Starbucks, and the ambiance is great. However, service was a major disappointment 30+ minute wait times even when it wasn't busy. On the plus side, the strong breeze outside were refreshing, but not so good AC.

place_name: The Coffee Bar, Gaisano Mall of Toril
review_text: Coffee Bar Toril is a really nice place with very good service. Special mention to Maam Jennie and Ivan, who are both friendly, accommodating, and attentive to customers. They make sure orders are handled well and always greet you with a warm attitude. Their good service really adds to the overall experience. I would definitely recommend this place for good coffee and great customer service.

place_name: The Coffee Bar, Gaisano Mall of Toril
review_text: Cold brew taste like burnt charcoal with no hint of coffee. Blueberries on my wafles taste like expired jam. Not worth its price. Street vendors have betrer tasting coffee and food with a fraction of the price. Place is nice though.

place_name: The Coffee Bar, Gaisano Mall of Toril
review_text: While I enjoyed the Alfredo pasta here, the service left much to be desired. Despite it not being busy, the 20+ minute wait times were frustrating. Additionally, the blended matcha fusion drink tasted more coffee, which was a letdown. The food was enjoyable, but the service needs improvement.

review_text: I love going here to work on my laptop they have a socket to charge my devices and they have a nice mountain view and I love the tableya drink.

place_name: The Coffee Bar, Gaisano Mall of Toril
review_text: The atmosphere is terrible for a coffee shop. It could be great, due to the view of the mountains, except for the very loud music just outside of the cafe. The coffee was cold and the staff seemed indifferent, or not very connected with the customer. I won't be going back.

place_name: The Coffee Bar, Gaisano Mall of Toril
review_text: It took 30 minutes for me to get a cafe latte and a ham and cheese sandwich that unlike the photo which shows that it is toasted is just plain white bread and the cheese is not melted at all. To add insult to injury they didn't have any tissues. i wish i could wipe my dirty hands on the manager's face for the extremely poor foresight of not seeing a box of tissues getting low and ordering more. completely inexcusable. **update 2025** i still go here and it's better. my biggest complaint is it's so cold inside. but definitely one of the best coffee shops in toril. not toasting a sandwich, AT ALL, while it is shown on the photo menu, is just ridiculous though.

place_name: The Coffee Bar, Gaisano Mall of Toril
review_text: This is my very first time to rate a resto/cafe and hear me out on this. This cafe has a very rude staff! Not exaggerating pero rude kaayo the way they take orders and even serve orders na padabog, a major disappointment indeed. I'm talking to you ate na naas counter nara bang may galit sa mundo. Moreover, it took so long for them to serve our orders, mind me ha, duha ka coffees lang and around 30 mins na serve. So if you're looking for a good and peaceful coffee break, do not go here!! WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS CAFE!
